turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My sister and I can't agree on how to get to the wedding next month.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me describe all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One way is to fly, which takes about two hours, but the tickets are expensive this close to the date.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is to take the train, around seven hours, but it's comfortable and we can work on the way.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or we could drive, which is cheapest split between two people, though it's a long day in the car.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's everything. Which one would you pick?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Will you need a car at the wedding location? If yes, driving together probably makes the most sense. If not, I'd take the train, it's much more relaxing than seven hours behind the wheel.
